h: Israel’s Shared Holiness Becomes Each Soul’s Torah Inheritance

p: "And it will be, because you will hearken" (Devarim 7:12).
"you will hearken," "and you will keep," "and you will do";
indicates as if pointing to the matter.
that this refers back to the last pasuk
and the statutes and the ordinances," etc.
שָׁם פָּתַח כִּי יְבִיאֲךָ וְגוֹמֵר (שָׁם ז, א)
it opens there "When Hashem your God brings you," etc. (ibid. 7:1),
the whole parashah in the singular;
"Not because you are more numerous," etc. (ibid. 7:7),
until the end of the parashah, in the singular.
that the entire Torah was said
to each individual Jew in particular,
just as the Ten Commandments were said
after the Jewish nation was formed;
that each and every Jew be
worthy of the words of Torah.
is the master of your powers.
אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ
"To the land that you are coming to, to possess it":
at first glance these five words
"to the land, and He will cast out," etc.
that the main holiness of Eretz Yisrael
is the nine kavin of wisdom
And as long as Eretz Yisrael was
in the hands of the nations,
what they drew from the nine kavin of wisdom
which is the aspect of "much wisdom."
they would have been given only
the five Chumashim of the Torah
which is the arrangement of Eretz Yisrael";
and took out of them all the vitality,
"You shall not let any soul live";
and the nine kavin of wisdom
remained in the hands of Yisrael.
Yisrael were exiled from the land,
nevertheless the nine kavin of wisdom
remained in the hands of Yisrael
that is, that each Jew will merit
that the Name Havayah be uniquely upon him
and be the master of his powers.
אֶל הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָא שָׁמָּה לְרִשְׁתָּהּ
"To the land that you are coming to, to possess it":
that it be like an inheritance,
that the nine kavin of wisdom
will remain in your hands forever,
even after they are exiled from the land,
and this is the expression "to possess it."
אָז וְנָשַׁל גּוֹיִם רַבִּים מִפָּנֶיךָ וְגוֹמֵר
Then, "And He will cast out many nations before you," etc.,
more numerous and mightier than you."
Certainly the pasuk is not speaking
of the powers of physical might
that the nations of the world possess,
of meriting the words of Torah,
"a wise man's heart is at his right hand" (Koheles 10:2),
so that one can attain a high level
at first one is called "many" and "great"
in the power of the Torah;
through the power of the Torah
so that it cannot enter the heart at all;
and this is called the level of "mighty."
the nations ruled in Eretz Yisrael,
and the nine kavin of wisdom were
they drew from the aspect of wisdom
And this is the meaning of the pasuk,
that they drew for the kelipah
And that is why it says "than you":
for this they took from the nine kavin of wisdom
and from the levels of holiness
וּנְתָנָם ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְפָנֶיךָ וְגוֹמֵר (שָׁם ז, ב)
"And Hashem your God will deliver them before you," etc. (ibid. 7:2):
to conquer all the power of the seven nations,
and to merit all the nine kavin of wisdom
וְאָז לֹא תְחַיֶּה מֵהֶם כָּל נְשָׁמָה
and then "you shall not let any soul of them live."

p: כִּי עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ וְגוֹמֵר
"For you are a holy people to Hashem your God," etc.
when Yisrael are on the highest level
will they be able to merit this,
would be able to merit it;
רַק אַף מִי שֶׁהוּא בִּבְחִינַת עַם
but even one who is in the aspect of am, "people,"
who is not on so high a level,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם עַם קָדוֹשׁ אַתָּה לַה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ
nevertheless "you are a holy people to Hashem your God,"
for the Name Havayah is the master of your powers.
to be a treasured people for Him";
בְּשֵׁם רַבֵּינוּ הַיְּהוּדִי הַקָּדוֹשׁ זֵכֶר צַדִּיק לִבְרָכָה
in the name of our Rebbe the holy Yid, zecher tzaddik livrachah,
מִכָּל מָקוֹם בָּחַר בָּהֶם מִכָּל הָעַמִּים
nevertheless He chose them from all the peoples.
Therefore it speaks in the singular,
once they became the Jewish nation,
opposite which are the seven shepherds.
"Not because you are more numerous than all the peoples
חָשַׁק ה׳ בְּאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
Hashem desired Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
recognition of the Kingship of Heaven
in all who come into the world.
And although all those he converted
returned to their ways after his death
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּפִרְקֵי דְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר פֶּרֶק כט)
(as written in Pirkei d'Rabbi Eliezer, chapter 29),
nevertheless his holiness and teaching benefited
the Jewish nation that came from him.
בְּמַדְרֵגַת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם גַּם כֵּן
in the level of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom, as well,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א ריט, א)
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponding to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
כִּי יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ וְגוֹמֵר
"For Yah has chosen Yaakov for Himself," etc.
"For you are the fewest of all the peoples":
corresponding to the holiness of Yosef HaTzaddik,
who brings out the sparks of holiness
and brought out the nine kavin of wisdom
which had been held captive under their dominion.
he would have been Mashiach ben Yosef;
and since they were not worthy,
a Mashiach ben Yosef from his seed,
who will gather Yisrael from all the nations,
of the ten kavin of wisdom
that came down to the world.
and take out of them all the vitality
וְאָז לֹא יִהְיֶה שָׂרִיד וְגוֹמֵר (עוֹבַדְיָה א, יח)
and then "there will be no survivor," etc. (Ovadiah 1:18).
"Rather, because of Hashem's love for you,"
corresponding to Moshe Rabbeinu, alav hashalom,
who brought down all the words of Torah,
שֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי אַהֲבַת ה׳ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
which comes through Hashem's love for Yisrael
"With an everlasting love You have loved us," etc.,
that He swore to your forefathers":
corresponding to the holiness of Aharon HaKohen,
and although they are not deserving,
by virtue of the oath to the Avos.
a seventh time in the plural,
"Hashem took you out with a strong hand";
and this corresponds to the holiness of
the middah of Malchus, Knesses Yisrael.
וְאַחַר כָּךְ חָזַר הַכָּתוּב בִּלְשׁוֹן יָחִיד
Afterward the pasuk returns to the singular,
"and He redeemed you from the house of bondage," etc.,
"Who keeps the covenant and the kindness."
who was the first to be circumcised at eight days
"But My covenant I will establish with Yitzchak");
וְגַם קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and also the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
with whom an eternal covenant was made for his seed,
"And He established it for Yaakov as a statute,
for Yisrael as an eternal covenant").
"To those who love Him and keep His commandments, to a thousand generations":
is the holiness of Avraham Avinu,
is the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
for so the count of a thousand generations
corresponding to the holiness of Avraham Avinu,
to bring down the words of Torah,
and he fulfilled the entire Torah
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponding to the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
that the words of Torah are engraved in the heart
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponding to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
for in the Torah there are also judgments,
in Parashas Bechukosai and Parashas Ki Savo.
And with each one is written
an alef, which indicates the words of Torah
which is from the World to Come,
"That I command you today, to do them":
along the lines of what is expounded (Sanhedrin 99b):
as if he made the words of Torah;
and as we said the explanation
of the declaration "We will do and we will hear":
that through the longing and the desire
thereby one "makes" the words of Torah.
